Press a keyboard key (Enter) and verify success

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { BrowserMode, PageAction, createEngine, interact } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: BrowserMode.Always } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await interact(engine, url, [{ selector: "#searchbox", type: "click" } as PageAction, { selector: "#searchbox", text: "test", type: "type" } as PageAction, { key: "Enter", type: "press" } as PageAction]);
  console.log(result.actionResults?.[2]?.success);
  console.log(result.actionResults?.[2]?.actionType);
  console.log(result.actionResults?.[2]?.actionIndex);
}

void main();
```
